name: Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

payment_behaviour.note: last 12m: 21 of 71 invoices paid >3 days late, max 9 days. Avg 2.1 days late; minor.

financial_health.signal: Family distributor, credit 179 unchanged; healthy. Idle shift = utilisation pressure.

notes: 9 renewals, asks avg 2.5%, settled 0.0% in 8 of 9 (EV-2026-70610-360010: asked 3.6, settled 0).

situation: Family fastener distributor (EUR 139 m, since 1929); we spend only ~EUR 40k (0.03% of its turnover) on M12 bolts (40%), nuts (30%) and washers (50%). It has idle capacity (second shift on hold since spring) and says it can take more parts at short notice. Our memo wants ONE supplier for the whole kit (~30,000 kits/yr: M12x40, M16x60, nut, washer), worth ~EUR 189k/yr at today's blended prices - about 4.7x its current business. It is already the cheapest on M12 bolts (12.46 vs 14.52) and nuts (4.91 vs 5.60).

pressures.evidence: Second shift on hold since spring; can take additional parts.
Kit bundle on offer; M16x60 (part:360011) would be new business.

what_it_values: filling idle capacity / the whole kit

likely_tradeables.give: whole kit: 570k M12 bolts, 180k M16 bolts, 630k nuts, 690k washers
likely_tradeables.get: kit prices at or below its current list (M16 below Mairhofer 37.64/100)
ppm cap + chargeback; 19 QNs in 12 m

arguments_that_should_land.argument: You told us you can take additional parts at short notice with the second shift idle: the full kit fills it.
Fastener producer prices rose only 1.7% yoy, so no increase is justified.

arguments_to_avoid.why: it is the cheapest and wants the work; win-win framing works

arguments_to_avoid.argument: Pressing >2% cut per part in one step

key_quotes.quote: they could take additional parts at short notice; the second shift has been on hold since spring.
We want one supplier for the kit.
